description: This file implements the core logic for discovering, monitoring, and controlling Philips Hue bridges and lights, including SSDP discovery, REST API interactions via libcurl, and callback mechanisms for state changes.

methods.name: philipsHueStartDiscoveringBridges
methods.description: Starts SSDP discovery for Philips Hue bridges with a callback for when a bridge is discovered.

methods.name: philipsHueStopDiscoveringBridges
methods.description: Stops SSDP discovery for Philips Hue bridges.

methods.name: philipsHueStartMonitoring
methods.description: Begins monitoring a specific Philips Hue bridge for light state changes and IP address updates.

methods.name: philipsHueStopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops monitoring a specific Philips Hue bridge.
